pages.text: A fungus grows fastest at its own temperature, falling off either side as e^(−((T − T_opt)/8)²), and it needs water, w/(0.3 + w); too wet, and bacteria outgrow it.
$(thing)Set$(): Moisture, Temperature.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Drafts: growth varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): Too wet: bacteria take the bed.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A mould near its best is fastest.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Growth, against its best: g = e^(−((T − T_opt)/8)²)·w/(0.3 + w) / its peak
